description: She wears a plum floor-length overdress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow sleeves, bordered in cream-gold geometric trim. Round brooches decorate the shoulder straps and a narrow decorated belt with round clasp marks the waist. A cream underdress appears in the central skirt panel; a cream embroidered wrap rests on the forearms. Small wrist jewelry and gold-brown embroidered shoes are visible. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
